product_metadata.title: Lily’s Home Tealight Wall Sconce, Hanging Metal Decor Art for 5 Candles
features: VINTAGE CONTEMPORARY FIXTURES: This beautiful wall sconce is a fun, vintage way to decorate your home. With its leafy floral gem design and matte black coating, this pretty wall fixture is a perfect addition to any house with a modern, country, or antique decor. Use it to add ambient light to any area of your home or office.

DESIGNED FOR TEALIGHT CANDLES: This decorative sconce is made with black metal and five glass tealight votive holders. You can either use 5 traditional tealight candles in the containers or a set of flameless LED candles, depending on your needs. Since this sconce does not require electricity, it’s perfect for anywhere inside or outside of your home.

FOR ALL AREAS OF THE HOME: These sconces are an excellent addition to any area of your home or office. Stop relying on industrial fluorescent lighting or cheap fixtures and place these sconces wherever you need a little extra light and sophistication. From the bedroom and bathroom to the living room, dining room, or entryway, these lights are a wonderful addition to any space.

EASY TO MOUNT: This sconce set is extremely easy to mount on any wall. They’re lightweight and unlike other hanging fixtures, the sconces attach flush to the wall for a classy, elegant look — simply hang it on a screw or nail. Whether you’re using it as an accent decoration or as a main source of light, this beautiful sconce will add a unique flair to your decor.

FOR INDOOR & OUTDOOR USE: Whether you need to decorate a modern family home or you’re looking to spruce up a farmhouse or barn space, this sconce is an ideal romantic lighting decoration. If it is placed outdoors, be sure to keep it in a covered location so it is protected from rain. Make this beautiful sconce a part of your home’s decor today!
description: Add a chic, modernistic look to any room with this striking wall candle sconce from Lily’s Home. The matte black finish lends drama to this artistic metal wall sconce. Add your favorite brightly colored candles for an ultra-artistic display. Try red, white, or yellow candles for an extra fun look. This sconce includes 5 tea light cups for use with tealight-sized candles only. You can use either traditional candles or flameless LED tealights. This sconce does not include candles, so you can choose whichever color or variety you prefer. This beautiful sconce has a diameter of 12.75” and can be used inside or outside. Hang it up on your patio wall, in the bathroom, dining room, or living room to add a polished look. It’s a great way to add a little bit of romantic lighting to your home, especially if you’re tired of bright overhead lights. It’s a classy, modern decoration that will look fantastic wherever you put it. This sconce also makes a lovely housewarming gift for loved ones settling into a new home. Its delicate leaf pattern and gem details can match easily with existing decor and it’s simple enough to fit into any room. The small loop on top of the sconce makes hanging this decoration quick and easy. Simply install a screw or nail into the wall, hook on the sconce, and you’re good to go. Its sturdy metal construction won’t easily bend or break, ensuring that this sconce will look beautiful for years. Whether you hang it in the bathroom or the den, it will add a pretty, elegant touch to your home.
